desc: Prove/verify the characterization: N is a 400 number iff N = m^2 where m has exactly 2 distinct prime factors (all exponents in N are 2× those in m, hence even; distinct prime count preserved).
Decide on per-query strategy: replace downward scan with O(1) prev-valid lookup array to eliminate gap/TLE risk entirely.
Implement sieve computing distinct prime factor count for 0..10^6 (increment omega[j] for multiples of each prime i detected by omega[i]==0).
Build prev-valid array: prev[i] = i if omega[i]==2 else prev[i-1].
For each query: s = prev[isqrt(A)], output s*s.
